scenarios.observed: DepositPaymentIntegrationTest on PostgreSQL: with a kitchen profile of 50% deposit, COD cap EGP 200.00 and an approved InstaPay recipient, a DEPOSIT quote of 27000 shows deposit 13500, remainder 13500 and the recipient; a COD quote above the cap is refused (COD_NOT_ELIGIBLE) and a small COD quote has no deposit; the placed order snapshots deposit, remainder, recipient and deadline in order_payment, cash due at hand-over is 13500; a later change of the kitchen's terms leaves the order unchanged, an UPDATE of the terms is refused (immutable), and a quote made before the change is refused at placement with 409 PRICE_CHANGED / PAYMENT_CHANGED.

Two concurrent customer transfer reports both answer 200 and record one CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED event; another customer gets 404; the kitchen may accept but prepare is refused 409 DEPOSIT_NOT_RECEIVED; another cook cannot report receipt (403/404); a different amount is refused 422; the exact amount moves the payment to KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED (response contains no 'verified'), after which prepare succeeds; the payment timeline is WAITING_FOR_DEPOSIT:CUSTOMER, CUSTOMER_TRANSFER_REPORTED:CUSTOMER, KITCHEN_RECEIPT_REPORTED:COOK. A COD order has no payment step (report refused 409; prepare allowed).

At the acceptance deadline the expiry job closes both deposit orders: the one with a reported transfer goes to payment RECONCILE_PENDING, the one without to EXPIRED; the order is EXPIRED and its capacity is released once. A deposit reported received just before expiry, and automatic reconciliation of a deposit for an accepted-but-unpaid order, are not covered here (documented limits; MB-052).

findings: MB-051 server part at 61d8dd5. Self-review, not independent review. Customer/kitchen screens are MB-053/MB-052; recipient approval by staff and mismatch/dispute paths are MB-052; live money is blocked by D16 gates.
